## Pull Request

Please go through these steps before submitting a PR.

1. Make sure that your PR is not a duplicate.
2. If not, then make sure that:

    a. You have tested the code yourself — the app builds, the hotkey arms, dictation runs end-to-end, and text injects correctly into at least one native macOS app.

    b. If your change touches the HUD, TextInjector, or HotkeyMonitor, verify that focus is never lost from the target app during a dictation cycle.

    c. UI changes include a screen recording or screenshots.

3. **After** these steps, you're ready to open a pull request.

    a. Your pull request MUST target the `main` branch.

    b. Give a descriptive title to your PR.

    c. Describe your changes.

    d. Put `closes #XXXX` in your description to link your PR to the issue(s) that it fixes (if applicable).

Please review the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) file for detailed contributing guidelines.

**PLEASE REMOVE THIS TEMPLATE BEFORE SUBMITTING**
